Deliver middleware guidance once per session without changing context order or rewriting the cached prefix. Permission guidance keeps message attribution intact, and extension hooks still run their policy and UI actions. Ordinary startup-hook context appends only when that hook's latest output changes. Receipts are checkpointed atomically with accepted context and shared until changed.

Bound retry waits, including Retry-After and jitter, by the configured maximum and stop retrying quota failures. Image generation is not automatically retried because an ambiguous failure can have already incurred a charge. Generic custom Responses endpoints no longer automatically advertise native image or voice catalogs; explicitly configured image IDs remain available. Protocol version remains 91.
